name: Cursed Carnival
source:
Lights up at the Bloodmoon Circus! Here, monsters take center stage, and every smile hides a secret. Will your story be a romance… or a tragedy?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
血月馬戲團，亮燈開場！在這裡，怪物站上舞臺中央，每個笑容都藏著秘密。你的故事會是一段戀曲……還是一出悲劇？

［摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian App[/url]］
